title: ONE 100 KT NUKE
ON WESTMINSTER
yt_title: One Nuke on London: Scotland Is Hit a Minute First #shorts
hook: One 100 kiloton warhead bursts over Westminster at 8:49 in the morning, a minute after another hits a submarine base in Scotland.

title: ONE 100 KT NUKE
OVER WHITEHALL
yt_title: What One Nuke Would Do to London, Ring by Ring #shorts
hook: The second simulated warhead bursts over Whitehall: a fireball 380 metres in radius, and at 640 metres heavy buildings do not stand.

title: ONE 100 KT NUKE
ON FASLANE
yt_title: One Nuke on Britain's Submarine Base: Simulated Faslane #shorts
hook: At 7.6 minutes the first simulated warhead bursts on the ground at Faslane, home of Britain's four Vanguard submarines, and the fallout drifts east.
